name: 89123 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89123 (Las Vegas) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89123 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89123 (Las Vegas) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
